text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Breeders' Cup, a true festival of 
racing, features GⅠ races under various 
conditions. Naturally, every single one of 
them is world-class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which of those races to target and 
dedicate the next two and a half years 
to—everyone's resolve seems set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To ensure we can compete in the races we 
enter, we must build up the team over the 
next two and a half years.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Those four over there are 
the team members under your direct 
supervision, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Prompted, I turn my eyes toward the sofa—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: <chrname> and a few others were talking.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Just because the other two won't be "team 
members," it doesn't mean they aren't 
aiming for the Breeders' Cup.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"As an individual goal, we are aiming for 
victory at the BC. Although the training 
schedules will differ—"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
There will surely be times when we act 
together. After all, we are companions 
chasing the very same dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are partners who will be working 
together for a long time to come. Let's 
hope they inspire each other to greater 
heights.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Now then, Trainer. Shall we begin? 
Our days as "DREAMS"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the journey to challenge the 
world's greatest G1 festival, the 
Breeders' Cup!
